newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Hapoalim sells Clal stake to IDB.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Hapoalim sells Clal stake to IDB.

text.p: Bank Hapoalim has sold a six percent stake in Clal Israel Ltd to IDB Development for 137 million shekels in an off-market transaction, the companies said.
The sale, which lowers Hapoalim's stake in Clal to 25 percent, was done in order to comply with Israeli law requiring banks to cut their stake in non-banking companies to 25 percent by year's end.
The sale was carried out at a price of 76 shekels per share. Clal closed on Sunday at 73.94 shekels.
IDB now controls nearly 43 percent of Clal. Both companies are major Israeli holding concerns.
